'''Fez Burba''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|seismologist]] working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He tasked a Republic spacer to take the seismic readings in [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] to prove his theory that [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] core was damaged by an Imperial bombardment. The readings turned out to be false and Burba went on with his next project.<ref name="TOR" /> The work brought him to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he speculated of large bodies of water hidden deep beneath the surface. Unfortunately, his data was stolen in a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] raid and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assistants were unable to retrieve it. Burba was forced to ask the spacer for assistance once more.<ref name="Buried Treasure">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Buried Treasure|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Later he was a special host in a show called [[Mysteries of Galactic Science]] quickly acquiring prominence. He also claimed that the shift of the planetary crust on [[Knores]] was the cause of extinction for an entire civilization. His theory was investigated in the equatorial trench.<ref name="Burba">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Burba-Assignment}}</ref>
